overview.description: The abrdn Physical Silver Shares ETF (SIVR) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the LBMA Silver Price index. The fund tracks the silver spot price, less trust expenses, using silver bullion. SIVR was launched on Jul 24, 2009 and is issued by aberdeen.
